findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 5 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 26 questions numbered 1-26; by section: 5.3 2, 5.4 2, 5.5 2, 5.6 2, 5.7 4, 5.8 2, 5.9 2, 5.11 2, 5.12 6, 5.14 2.

The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
